result.title: Gaussians Can Subtract: Neural Dissolve Fields for Hybrid Scene Rendering
result.comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. 16 pages including supplementary material, 11 figures, 8 tables. Project page: https://ooosn.github.io/gaussians-can-subtract/
result.summary: Hybrid Mesh-Gaussian rendering combines compact textured surfaces with flexible 3D Gaussian primitives, offering an efficient alternative to purely Gaussian scene representations for structured environments. Existing scene-reconstruction hybrids commonly follow an additive formulation, where Gaussian residuals compensate for errors left by the mesh. However, not every Mesh-Gaussian conflict is caused by missing content: residual geometry errors, occlusion mismatch, texture-projection artifacts, and view-dependent appearance can make the same mesh content consistent in one view but inconsistent in another. We therefore formulate hybrid rendering as a multi-view inconsistency problem and present Gaussolve, a subtract-and-refill framework that selectively dissolves inconsistent mesh content before residual Gaussians refill the revealed regions. We introduce a lightweight Neural Dissolve Field, parameterized by scalar spherical-harmonic Gaussians, to learn where and from which viewing directions mesh content should be dissolved. A continuous transmittance fusion rule progressively exposes residual Gaussians behind the dissolved mesh, preserving their reconstruction gradients and avoiding hard visibility discontinuities. Experiments on structured and semi-structured scenes demonstrate higher visual fidelity with fewer Gaussian primitives and faster rendering. Project page: https://ooosn.github.io/gaussians-can-subtract/

AI.brief_summary: 该论文将 Mesh–Gaussian 混合场景重建表述为多视角不一致问题，提出「先溶解后补填」框架与轻量 Neural Dissolve Field，学习在哪些视角方向上溶解网格内容并让残差 Gaussian 补全，从而以更少 primitives 获得更高视觉保真度与更快渲染。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于三维重建与神经渲染的表示/渲染效率研究，不涉及 VLM 推理状态、视觉证据筛选或 THINK/LOOK/STOP 等决策过程，其「溶解」机制也仅是渲染可见性控制，未提供可迁移到 latent visual reasoning 的具体线索。
